mapper.sql: r.LIVE_ROOM_SEQ, r.HOST_SEQ, r.TITLE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.THUMBNAIL_URL, r.STATUS, r.CATEGORY, r.STARTED_AT, r.ENDED_AT, r.CREATED_AT, r.DISCONNECTED_AT, r.ENDED_BY, r.END_REASON, m.LOGIN_ID AS HOST_LOGIN_ID, m.NICKNAME AS HOST_NICKNAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIVE_VIEWER v WHERE v.LIVE_ROOM_SEQ = r.LIVE_ROOM_SEQ AND v.LEFT_AT IS NULL) AS VIEWER_COUNT

mapper.update: UPDATE LIVE_ROOM SET STATUS = 'ENDED', ENDED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, ENDED_BY = #{endedBy}, END_REASON = #{endReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE LIVE_ROOM_SEQ = #{liveRoomSeq} AND STATUS = 'LIVE'

UPDATE LIVE_ROOM SET TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CATEGORY = #{category}, THUMBNAIL_URL = #{thumbnail_url, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE LIVE_ROOM_SEQ = #{live_room_seq} AND STATUS = 'LIVE'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIVE_HASHTAG (LIVE_HASHTAG_SEQ, LIVE_ROOM_SEQ, TAG) VALUES (LIVE_HASHTAG_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{liveRoomSeq}, #{tag})

mapper.update: UPDATE LIVE_VIEWER SET LEFT_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE LIVE_ROOM_SEQ = #{liveRoomSeq} AND LEFT_AT IS NULL

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIVE_BAN (LIVE_BAN_SEQ, HOST_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, CREATED_AT) VALUES (LIVE_BAN_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{hostSeq}, #{memberSeq}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT b.MEMBER_SEQ, m.LOGIN_ID, m.NICKNAME, b.CREATED_AT AS BANNED_AT FROM LIVE_BAN b JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_SEQ = b.MEMBER_SEQ WHERE b.HOST_SEQ = #{hostSeq} ORDER BY b.CREATED_AT DESC
